policy.causalRule: OLS4 uses only four consecutive observations before the target quarter. It never uses the following-quarter value. Conservative availability is the following actual observation's sourceFiled date.
policy.retrospectiveRule: The OLS4/next-actual average is a separate two-sided smoother, uses future information and is unavailable before the following actual sourceFiled date. Never substitute it into an earlier signal.
